exploratory.limitation: Default-feature test-fast opt-level=1 with debug assertions/overflow checks; 119.0671 to 117.1300 billion analysis instructions is an exploratory filter, never pooled with max-perf PGO results.

first.counter_scope: Events explicitly enabled at analysis entry and disabled at analysis completion using perf FIFO acknowledgements; startup excluded

confirmation.counter_scope: Events explicitly enabled at analysis entry and disabled at analysis completion using perf FIFO acknowledgements; startup excluded

application.scope: Analysis timers exclude startup; perf whole-command counters include startup. Fresh result-cache storage, five files, twenty findings and complete ordinary output match PHP.

controls.selection_rule: Independently confirm every first-pass control median outside the one-percent envelope, including improvements
controls.scales_note: Separate first/confirmation distributions; iteration counts may differ.

frontend.probe: Every confirmed control timing regression beyond one percent; separate instruction-supply diagnostic window

profile_evidence.scope: Exact analysis-only Callgrind attribution; independent from native counters.

opcode_body_accounting.note: Exact recorded PC instruction costs grouped only when the executed/direct machine CFG is reachable from one opcode target without crossing central dispatch. Shared tails, setup and called functions are not attributed to an individual opcode. Direct conditional edges are conservative; this is a lower bound for each body, not an inclusive opcode cost.

selection_counts.interpretation: Initial total-width counts include already optimized prefix-only intervals. Refined opportunities precede pending cleanup; actual post-cleanup completions are recorded independently in coverage.

retained: exact active baseline and candidate executables

acceptance.control_tradeoff: Instruction priority accepts the verified application reduction. Confirmed shared-frame, inherited-method and shared-temp timing regressions remain visible; no broad speedup claim. Separate frontend counters associate them with instruction supply; exact causal code placement is unproven.

limitations: PHPStan parity remains open; no claim of the requested 50–60 billion intermediate level or final PHP parity.
Native evidence is x86-64 only; ARM64 evidence unavailable.
Existing sole-owner eligibility, pending-call ordering, read-snapshot query, cycle admission and canonical final/multiple-owner planner remain unchanged.
Actual completion counts include bootstrap from a distinct default-feature diagnostic binary, not native phase timing claims.
Existing callback-last-owner and named-function self compile-time gaps remain baseline-equal failures, never PHP passes.
No PHPStan workload or independent holdout was used in the 18-input PGO training.
